speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: You look toward "Aemeath." She is quietly resting on the sofa, eyes closed.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: A console and two controllers rest before the sofa, with a game loaded. It looks like a perfect nook for two to play shoulder-to-shoulder or snuggle through a mellow winter afternoon.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Is "she" asleep? Does "she" dream as well?

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: You have no way of knowing.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: You look toward "Aemeath." She hunches over the workbench, head tilted as she pores over the display.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: This was where you used to work and the usual haunt for young Aemeath. When you were busy, she would sit beside you and draw in silence, like a small, loyal guardian keeping watch.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Now, the tabletop is covered by a thin layer of dust.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: You look toward "Aemeath." She sits motionless by the shore of the Ginnungamere, her gaze fixed on the water, where glistening lights dance on the ripples

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: This lake is where everything began, and where everything comes to an end. It is here that your paths first crossed, and here that they finally diverged.

speaker: Speaker_84_Name
anh_en: Like a pebble into the lake, these memories make only a small splash in the waters of fate. The ripples soon fade.

Fortunately, most of the energy conversion array built on top remained functional. So the team decided to retract the foundations to prevent further wear. The Suspension Platform is the Observatory's primary support and control core. Restoring it calls for no small amount of resources and effort. Let's get through it together.\n("The Suspension Platform we're rebuilding won't just support the main body of the Spacetrek Observatory, it will also become the primary workspace for the researchers. Its upper level will even feature an open plaza where people can relax and enjoy the view of the Etching Plains. I can't wait to see the platform after it's fully restored," says Dhalifa!)
The Platform Phase is complete. The next phase is the Overwatch Phase.\n\nThe Spacetrek Collective will forever honor your service!
Continue rebuilding the route network and raise Network Activity to 1,200 points

When the Spacetrek Observatory first began recording Lahai-Roi's ecology, climate, and landscapes, many researchers who had worked tirelessly for it broke into tears. It was our way of resisting the Void Storms that could erase even existence. And now, with your help, we stand only one step from rebuilding it. I hope you, too, will feel what we felt on that day! (So says Dhalifa!)

You have successfully rebuilt the Spacetrek Observatory. Lahai-Roi's charting and monitoring systems have been fully reactivated. Your contribution is of substantial importance.\n\nThe Spacetrek Collective will forever honor your service!

Now that the Spacetrek Observatory is operating again, Lahai-Roi's long-shut eyes have reopened. Everything it observes is once more captured in tangible records, streams of data flowing into the Suspension Platform like the pulse of the earth. The researchers will analyze, interpret, and archive this information to assist the Spacetrek Collective in studying Void Storm activity.
The Spacetrek Observatory is now fully rebuilt.

The Pioneer Association, originally known as the Universal Geography Association, is a scientific and educational organization established before the Lament.\n\nAfter the Ebb Tide, the Association collaborated with scientists, photographers, and journalists to continue exploring the mysterious world after the disaster, and shared the discoveries with the public through magazines, maps, books, on-site entertainment experience projects, and interactive media, attracting a large fan base in the six regions.

Lollo Logistics is a widely respected global transportation company, known for successfully handling high-risk transportation assignments. Their philosophy of "harmony brings wealth" guides their team in choosing peaceful resolutions to any challenges they may face.

The Cruising Drake, a group of inventors and enthusiasts scattered throughout Huanglong, set up shop in the bustling Jiaolong Repair Shop. They are known for their love of gang culture and their ability to raise funds for their ventures. Their specialties include causing mischief and creating innovative inventions.

Exiles is the general term for groups of people who wander outside the city and live by crime and scavenging. The Exiles do not have a unified organizational structure, and the strongest person in each camp will act as the leader to give orders. In the Huanglong area, they are mainly concentrated in the Wuming Bay. Due to the large number of people and different ideas, two gangs have been formed. The "Boar Gang", for some reasons, seems to be not so repulsive to outsiders.

A clandestine organization with an extreme obsession with power and progress that borders on macabre. The Fractsidus members are rumored to possess an unusual appearance, but further details are still being uncovered through ongoing investigations.

The Black Shores are a mysterious organization dedicated to saving the world from destruction. They travel to the most perilous places, recruiting brave allies and never losing their idealistic passion. Those who join or are invited to their island will don the emblem of a Blake Bloom as a symbol of their membership.
